heading: Simplicity And Ownership / Simple, Easy, And Complection
rationale: Make the new nested Core definitions a first-class graph owner without absorbing Architecture's composed-design admission or pre-existing Simplicity And Ownership prose.

heading: Composed Design Admission
rationale: Own artifact, post-boundary composition, representative-change, Depth, Locality, cumulative machinery, and deletion admission.

heading: Acceptance Is A Set Of Claims
rationale: Deepen the existing owner with permanent-evidence marginal value, overlap, lifecycle cost, exact-byte purpose, and retention/removal triggers without prescribing adopter enforcement tooling.

heading: Validation Proof Lifetime
rationale: Register the existing sufficient proof-lifetime owner without redundant normative wording; inspect repeated validation as an application question.

heading: Invariant Contracts
rationale: Narrow the current universal failure-mechanism prohibition by distinguishing contained programming defects from arbitrary input, escaping invalid state, and authoritative-state corruption.

heading: Immutable Authority Closure
rationale: Scale semantic closure to the actual supported lifetime and reconstruction promise without requiring separate identity, codec, handle, version, ordinal, and lifecycle objects.

heading: Version Scope And Invalidation
rationale: Separate format, identity, compatibility, migration, and ordinal roles; admit matrices only for actual supported consumer combinations and cumulative obligations.

heading: Implementation Versus Dependency
rationale: Compare established tooling when standardized semantics would be reimplemented; preserve thin adapters and domain-specific products, and apply the decision at creation, material extension, or renewal rather than as automatic retroactive deletion.

heading: Required Active-Plan Fields
rationale: Require composed-design applicability and applicable review content in written plans.

heading: Re-Planning
rationale: Re-run composed-design admission when replacement or accumulation changes the artifact.

heading: Systemic-Finding Re-Planning
rationale: Expand for a new semantic consumer, owner, risk, or promise; stop at the dispositioned owner/reachable population and admit deletion, smaller Interfaces, proof substitution, and composition comparison as repairs.

heading: Policy Projection Completeness
rationale: Retain the project-agnostic rule; the prototype supports a separate Coding Standards Python implementation review, not a normative revision with an excluded known consumer.
